protocol.scope: one real-model forward/backward integration batch, no optimizer construction or updates
protocol.initialization: original zero LoRA initialization shared with archived corrected A/B, no continuation from trained A/B

generation.fixed_questions: first four questions of previously completed corrected B first batch; IDs frozen before generation
generation.prompt: frozen existing prepared prompt, identical for both arms

signal.P_VR: unchanged verifier outcome with official sequence leave-one-out, no PRM dependence
signal.P_PRM: official frozen two-class logits, signed score, softmin temperature .1, coefficient 1, actual-peer-length token baseline
signal.kl: official k1 old_logp - reference_logp, action masked; subtract before cumulative return
signal.kl_coefficient_source: official examples/scripts/train_pure.sh:32; explicit override of CLI default .01
signal.boundaries: official token-based separator detection and processed final action, shared by both arms
signal.normalization: exact official replay-buffer normalize once, preserve zero advantages, no GRPO normalization
signal.loss: pinned official PolicyLoss, clip .2, one response per microbatch, accumulate 1/32
signal.all_zero_batch: explicit validation failure; no replacement reward or automatic resampling

protocol.official_eos_handling: retain raw emitted IDs and exact official process_sequences output separately; score/logprob/loss use processed IDs
protocol.verifier_adaptation: retain archived repaired verifier on raw emitted text and original termination; inserted EOS never certifies truncated completion
resource_adaptations: one shared A100 80GB, current validated TRL backend only for model/LoRA/vLLM initialization
all TRL reward, advantage, compute_loss, train and optimizer creation paths blocked
single-card LoRA, 32 responses and 2048-token cap instead of paper distributed settings
single-example unpadded PRM forward; native BF16 GPU logits-to-softmin transform followed by FP32 task matrix and CPU signal reductions
original data, prompt and verifier retained, so not an end-to-end paper accuracy reproduction
acceptance: exact emitted IDs and official processed IDs saved
each step reward maps once to a valid actor boundary, terminal EOS distinguished from inserted EOS
one normalization before microbatch loss and sealed advantages unchanged
PRM-only signals independent of outcomes, VR responds to outcomes
finite real model gradients in both arms, no optimizer instantiated or stepped
complete actor and PRM parameter hashes unchanged
old A/B and veRL source/result hashes and inventories unchanged
record stage-specific CUDA and process/device NVML memory plus generation/PRM/backward timing
